news.text: 🗣 Jorge Jesus, coach of Portugal: "I liked Francisco #Conceição a lot. He felt pain after the knock, he is not at his best, but he fought and brought quality to our play".✅ Good news for #Juventus: the Portuguese medical staff, who are currently handling the player's condition, have already provided positive signals this evening.[Fabrizio Romano via @juventusinsidernews]

"LUCIO'S #JUVE IS READY TO TAKE OFF"Interview with Sabatini#Spalletti's ex sporting director: "His teams need a long runway to taxi, but once they lift off the ground... He just needs to recover a couple of midfielders, then you'll see".[Front Page TuttoSport]

Zeki #Celik from the Turkish national team camp: "The experience at #Juventus is important: I am happy to be a bianconero, I'm learning a lot from the new coach and what I learn I try to bring to the national team"[Mirko Nicolino]

#Juve, the value of #Palmisani is on the rise. While 8 million was enough in the summer, today much more is needed to secure the young #Frosinone goalkeeper.He is with the Under 21. In June #Frosinone was asking 8-9: now roughly double is needed.With @fabiosple @CorSport[Eleonora Trotta]

🧐❗️For the midfield, #Juventus is looking to the future and is tracking #Bakola: #Carnevali knows him well and is seriously considering the move. #Roma is also interested in him. For January, on the other hand, the bianconeri have reopened contacts for #AitNouri: he is currently finding little playing time and the management aims to exploit the situation by trying to sign him on loan with a potential option to buy. #Inter is also monitoring his situation.[Niccolò Ceccarini - TMW via @juventusinsidernews]

🇫🇷✍️ #Kalulu-#Juventus, renewal talks underway: he earns €2.5M, he has a contract until 2029 and the club is evaluating an important wage adjustment and extension to recognize his role as a leader. His versatility, reliability and positive attitude have convinced the management to invest in him for the long term. Furthermore, his agent would be willing to keep the financial demands completely reasonable.[Giovanni Albanese - Gazzetta dello Sport via @juventusinsidernews]

🧤🧐 "#Neto will be officially announced tomorrow: he will only fill the gap left by #Grabara, who is unlikely to stay. #Juventus will therefore need to sign another goalkeeper, probably a young one, who can compete for the starting spot with #Vicario, for whom the chances for a permanent confirmation are increasing (buyout at €10M). The name of #Palmisani (€20M€) is confirmed: the bianconeri are tracking him, even though he is not the only one being monitored."[Nicolò Schira - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]
🆗 Francisco #Conceição came back on the pitch for the second half, everything is ok for the #Juventus winger.[@juventusinsidernews]
🚑 "Injury for Chico #Conceição with Portugal against Norway.The #Juventus winger leaves the pitch in pain and will be evaluated by the medical staff."[@FabrizioRomano via @PuebloJ]

🇧🇦🆙 #Spalletti sees enormous potential in #Alajbegovic, he would have liked to integrate him gradually, but the injuries have accelerated his timeline. The coach highly appreciates his quality and ability to create plays, but is asking him to improve his movement off the ball and his reading of match situations. He also wants to test him as a number 10 and central playmaker, aiming to make him a more complete player.[TuttoSport via @juventusinsidernews]

🇩🇪👀 #Spalletti wants to make the most of #Woltemade after the international break and the three solutions he is studying are playing him as an attacking midfielder behind #KoloMuani, as a false 9 or alternating him with the Frenchman. The coach will follow him during his international duties with Germany to further study his characteristics and utilization: he believes in him heavily. October could be the decisive month for his integration into the bianconero squad.[Gazzetta dello Sport via @juventusinsidernews]
